subject: POC prompt dataset collection and eval plan - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC prompt dataset collection and eval plan - Acme Health

Hi Alice —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan for the POC. Thanks for sharing context on the use case (automated patient intake summarization + suggested next actions).

Recap / success criteria (proposed)
- Coverage: POC uses ~1k representative prompts/chat-turns you provide (mix of short intake questions and multi-turn threads).
- Quality: human-rated summary accuracy >= 0.88 (average of 3 raters) on the labeled eval set.
- Latency: median end-to-end generation latency < 250ms for 512-token windows on dedicated instance.
- Safety: no PHI leakage beyond provided prompt content; opt-out handling validated.
- Cost: baseline unit cost estimate provided; target is <= 0.6x current per-request cost.

Evaluation plan (high-level)
1) You provide prompt set + ~200 redlines/labeled expected outputs for a subset (we can use your annotators or Redwood can help).
2) We run baseline models (open checkpoints) and Redwood-optimized runtime.
3) Metrics: ROUGE-L, semantic similarity (embedding cosine), and human accuracy on labeled subset.
4) Run a small A/B vs your current system (if available) for qualitative assessment.

Deliverables and owners
- Prompt/template: please drop your prompts and any redlines into the Drive folder (link below) or attach to reply — Owner: Acme (Alice / Tom)
- Baseline run + eval: Redwood SE (Aditya) to run and produce metrics + short findings doc — Owner: Aditya
- Commercial / SOW: Rishi (Rishi) to draft POC SOW and timeline — Owner: Rishi

Timeline (proposed)
- 6/26: Acme uploads prompts + chat logs (or confirms they will be provided by 6/29).
- 6/30: Redwood confirms dataset ingestion and any missing metadata.
- Week of 7/6: Run initial eval & deliver draft results by 7/10.

Attached: prompt_template.csv — small template to map prompt type, expected output, and anonymization notes.
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-poc-prompts

Questions / asks for you now:
- Can you confirm who on your side will own uploading the prompts and labeling (name/email)?
- Any restrictions on sample export or retention we should be aware of (security/compliance)?

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Marissa
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments:
- prompt_template.csv (CSV template, 3 cols: prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_output)

Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset collection and eval plan - Acme Health

Thanks Marissa — great plan. We're aligned and attaching an initial export.

What's attached:
- acme_prompts_v1.csv: ~1,050 rows (anonymized patient intake prompts + metadata: department, intent).
- acme_chat_logs_2026-06-20.json: 200 multi-turn sessions exported from our chat system (PHI partially redacted).

Notes from our side:
- Owners: I'll own the prompt upload and coordination (alice.jenkins@acmehealth.com). Tom (cc'd) will coordinate labeling resources; we expect to provide 200 labeled expected outputs by 7/2.
- Security: our InfoSec wants confirmation on retention and movement of these logs. We need a short note that Redwood will not persist raw logs beyond the POC retention window (30 days) unless we sign an MSA with export controls.
- Format: prompts CSV has columns prompt_id, prompt_text, dept, channel. We didn't include expected_output except for the 200 labeled rows in a separate sheet.

Next steps: please confirm Redwood can ingest these files as-is and any changes needed. Also please share the eval rubric you'd use so our labeling team can match format.

Thanks,
Alice
Senior Product Manager — Conversational AI
Acme Health

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC prompt dataset collection and eval plan - Acme Health

Hi Alice — thanks for the files, I pulled them down and did a quick pass. We can ingest as-is with only small reshaping. Quick tech plan and checklist from our side:

Ingest checklist (what I'll do)
- Validate CSV schema and normalize prompt_id and dept labels. (ETA: 6/30)
- Convert chat logs into flattened prompt-response pairs for model eval; maintain session ids for context evaluation.
- Anonymization: we'll run a secondary PHI check and generate a redacted export for evaluation runs; original raw logs will be stored in encrypted S3 with access-limited keys until you confirm retention policy.

Eval plan (detailed)
- Dataset split: 70% train-like (for fine-tuning if requested), 20% eval, 10% holdout. For this POC we'll only run inference/eval on the 20% labeled set + holdout for spot checks.
- Baselines: run two open models (small/medium) plus our optimized runtime with a recommended quantization profile.
- Metrics: ROUGE-L, BLEU, embedding cosine vs labeled answer, plus human accuracy (3 raters) on the 200 labeled rows. We'll produce per-dept metrics.
- Runtime tests: measure median latency and p95 on the expected request mix (single-turn and 3-turn context).

Security/retention note for InfoSec:
- For POC we propose a 30-day retention window for raw logs on Redwood-stored S3; access only via SE team-managed keys. We will provide a short security summary (SOC 2 controls, encryption-at-rest, IAM logs) and can add the retention clause into the POC SOW.

Deliverables & timeline
- 6/30: Redwood confirms ingestion status and any schema issues.
- 7/6: Initial eval run (metrics + latency) delivered as a short results doc.
- 7/10: Human evaluation results + summary with recommended tuning (prompt templates, quantization).

Action items assigned
- Aditya: run ingestion + baseline eval (ETA 6/30 ingest, 7/6 baseline results).
- Alice: confirm retention policy acceptance or suggest alternate wording (by 6/29).
- Rishi: share draft SOW and MSA link; will follow up on pricing/credits.

If anyone wants a quick call Monday to walk through the data shape for the labeling team, I'm available 7/29 AM PST. (typo: meant to say 6/29 — available morning; apologies)

Thanks,
Aditya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Thanks team — good progress. Quick confirm: we can start the POC run the week of 7/6 once Aditya confirms ingestion. Rishi will follow up with a POC SOW and the MSA link (DocuSign) by 7/1.

Acceptance criteria (finalized for POC):
- Functional: average human-rated accuracy >= 0.88 on the labeled eval set (200 rows).
- Performance: median latency < 250ms, p95 < 800ms for the mixed request profile.
- Security: Redwood will apply 30-day retention on raw logs for the POC; we will provide the security summary doc and include the retention clause in the SOW.
- Business: mutual demo of results + decision meeting by 7/15 to discuss expansion.

Next steps / owners (summary)
- Alice: Confirm retention policy (by 6/29) and upload any missing labeled rows.
- Aditya: Ingest files and report status (by 6/30).
- Rishi: Send POC SOW and MSA/DocuSign link (by 7/1).
- Marissa: Schedule 7/15 decision meeting and prepare demo agenda.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for the 7/15 decision meeting once Rishi shares the SOW. Excited to get this rolling.

Best,
